case_01.title: Heavy Floor Wax Stain
observedFacts: A 45-cm skid mark is visible on the parquet floor near the balcony sliding door.
Uncured floor wax chemical residue is concentrated along the edge.

case_01.title: Latent Fingerprint on Glass Frame
observedFacts: An overlapped latent fingerprint was recovered from the interior sliding glass frame.
Initial ridge minutiae matching identifies the print as belonging to Somchai.

case_01.title: Torn Shirt Button
observedFacts: A mother-of-pearl button with frayed thread was found near the desk corner.
The victim's shirt was missing its second button, with thread fibers pulled violently.

case_01.title: Fresh Blood Spatter on Balcony Rail
observedFacts: Fresh blood spatter is present on the metal railing 95 cm above floor level.
The victim suffered a posterior scalp laceration matching the railing width.

case_01.title: Teacup with White Sediment
observedFacts: Two teacups were found on the desk; one contained leftover tea with fine white sediment.
Laboratory screening detected fast-acting sedative drug contamination.

case_02.title: Empty Picture Frame
observedFacts: The canvas was severed neatly along all four inner edges of the wooden frame.
A heavy-duty utility knife blade was found dropped on the floor.

case_02.title: Muddy Shoeprint Impressions
observedFacts: Three fresh wet mud shoeprint impressions lead from the rear garden door toward the gallery.
Athletic shoe tread pattern matching Size 42 (EU).

case_02.title: Digital Keycard Access Log (22:42)
observedFacts: The system logged Keycard M-01 (Master Card) tapping the gallery door lock at 22:42:15.
Keycard M-01 is registered to Curator Methavee.

case_02.title: Red Jacket Polyester Fibers
observedFacts: Two bright red synthetic fibers were snagged on the rear door latch metal burr.
FTIR spectroscopy confirmed red polyester fiber composition.

case_02.title: Severed CCTV Power Cable
observedFacts: The CCTV camera in the blind spot had its power and video cables severed.
Cut marks match diagonal wire-cutting pliers.

case_03.title: 18-Meter Skid Mark
observedFacts: A continuous 18-meter straight black tire skid mark was measured on the asphalt prior to impact.
Road surface was wet due to rainfall; friction coefficient (f) estimated at 0.50.

case_03.title: Blue Metallic Paint Flakes on Garment
observedFacts: Blue metallic paint flakes were recovered from the victim's jacket.
Microscopic layer analysis revealed Clear coat, Blue base coat, and 3 Primer layers.

case_03.title: Headlight Glass & Polycarbonate Fragments
observedFacts: Polycarbonate headlight fragments were scattered in a 45-degree fan pattern.
Fragment code markings identify manufacturer and specific pickup truck model.

case_03.title: Flashing Traffic Signal
observedFacts: Traffic camera logs confirm signals were in flashing amber/red caution mode due to system fault at 20:18.
Drivers are required by law to reduce speed and yield at flashing caution signals.

case_03.title: Right Leg Bumper Fracture
observedFacts: Victim suffered a right lower leg bumper fracture 42 cm above heel level.
Horizontal contusion present on the right thigh.
